# Data Center Training

> Data Center Training (datacentertraining.us) is a specialty training division of HAZWOPER-OSHA Training, LLC, an IACET-accredited provider of professional data center and safety compliance training. We offer 44 online courses (250 hours total) covering data center design, operations, power, cooling, security, and facilities management, self-paced with a certificate on completion.

Courses start at $99.99 each, or enroll the complete catalog bundle for $2,928.99. Programs are grouped into Comprehensive Programs (12-18 hrs, full-discipline curriculum) and Modular Specializations (1-8 hrs, focused hands-on skills).

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://datacentertraining.us/): Overview, hero, and links to every section of the site.
- [Course Catalog](https://datacentertraining.us/courses.html): All 44 courses with search, sort, and filter by track, duration, or price.
- [Bundles](https://datacentertraining.us/bundles.html): 7 role-based and complete-catalog bundles, up to 53% off.
- [Who It's For](https://datacentertraining.us/who.html): Role-based course recommendations (electricians, HVAC techs, security officers, engineers, and more).
- [Certifications & Accreditations](https://datacentertraining.us/certifications.html): IACET accreditation, BBB, Trustpilot, Google reviews, and credential transparency.
- [FAQ](https://datacentertraining.us/faq.html): Common questions about programs, pricing, and certificates.
- [Sitemap](https://datacentertraining.us/sitemap.xml): Complete list of pages.
- [llms-full.txt](https://datacentertraining.us/llms-full.txt): Full course catalog and pricing in Markdown.
